description: This file is a front-end HTML document that provides a user interface for visualizing and browsing database schemas and data. It includes embedded CSS for styling and JavaScript for fetching data via API endpoints, rendering database lists, tables, and data with interactive features such as expanding cell content.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the server and renders them in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, resets current selections, and updates the UI.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the database to show associated tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for a given database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches data for a selected table and renders it in the main content area.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Creates an HTML table from data array and inserts into container.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Generates HTML for individual cell content, handling objects, large strings, and nulls.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content to show full text or object details.
